budget.development_usage_reference: about 828 tokens across four Day 1 preflight calls without excerpts
budget.price_snapshot: not recorded; cost is reported as unknown until a dated price is captured
budget.rule: If measured usage after the first balanced block exceeds the usable credit minus the reserve, stop and declare the predeclared R6/V6 fallback before continuing.

configuration_freeze: B-19 on 20 October freezes runtime commit, prompts, model, image, budgets
contamination_status: untouched holdout: assets are hash-locked and committed before any trial; the repository is public, so the holdout is untouched-by-tuning rather than secret

fallback.rule: May be selected only before the first final trial, for a stated reserve or time reason; results are then reported as R6/V6, never as R12/V12.
